claimed_coverage: Tests verify duplicate attribute handling in shader-utils.js emits warnings instead of errors, and that particle_cpu.js and particle_init.js wrap internalTex0/1/2 sampler uniforms in #ifdef PARTICLE_GPU blocks to prevent undefined-uniform errors on WebGPU CPU particle paths.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix adds duplicate attribute detection with a warning in shader-utils.js collectAttributes method, and wraps internalTex0/1/2 sampler uniforms in #ifdef PARTICLE_GPU blocks in particle_cpu.js and particle_init.js to conditionally include them only for GPU particle simulations.
issue_context_used: The issue describes CPU particle simulations failing on WebGPU due to duplicate attribute extraction causing warnings/errors and unused sampler uniforms causing undefined-uniform errors; tests verify both fixes are in place.
notes: Created two hidden test files: (1) test-shader-utils-duplicate-attrs.test.mjs tests the duplicate attribute handling in ShaderUtils.collectAttributes using Mocha/Chai framework consistent with existing project tests; (2) test-particle-shader-conditionals.test.mjs verifies the conditional #ifdef PARTICLE_GPU blocks around sampler uniforms in particle_cpu.js and particle_init.js. Tests run from /workspace using npm test command with external test paths. Updated eval.sh to emit explicit 'TEST RESULT: PASSED' or 'TEST RESULT: FAILED' summary lines between the Start/End Test Output markers to ensure verifier can recognize test-runner signals.
